jean-pierre ferland.bio: Montréal-born Jean-Pierre Ferland was one of Québec's defining singer-songwriters, writing hundreds of songs across a six-decade career and helping modernize francophone pop with landmark records including Jaune.

jean françois breau.bio: Acadian singer-songwriter Jean-François Breau was born in Ontario and raised in Tracadie-Sheila, New Brunswick, building a francophone career through solo records, musical theatre and the Canadian group Salebarbes.

kim davis.bio: Toronto-born Kim Davis is a Canadian R&B and soul singer-songwriter whose solo work blends R&B, hip-hop, soul and reggae and has earned Juno nominations in both reggae and R&B categories.

king reign.bio: Toronto-born MC King Reign was a respected Canadian hip-hop storyteller known for detailed, soulful writing, collaborations with artists including Saukrates and Kardinal Offishall and a lasting influence on the city's rap community.

jesse labelle.bio: Toronto-born singer-songwriter Jesse Labelle built his career as a pop and country songwriter and performer, moving from local rock bands and collaborations into solo releases and songwriting work in Toronto and Nashville.

judith bérard.bio: Montréal-born Judith Bérard is a Canadian singer-songwriter and actor whose career spans Québec television, pop music and musical theatre, including a long-running turn as Cristal in Starmania.

poizunus.bio: Toronto artist Poizunus is a Canadian beatboxer, DJ and producer who has competed internationally, appeared on MuchMusic and become a veteran figure in Canada's beatboxing community.

lightman jarvis ecstatic band.bio: Lightman Jarvis Ecstatic Band is the Canadian experimental duo of Toronto-born Romy Lightman and Montréal artist Yves Jarvis, blending psych-folk, neo-soul, dream pop and improvised indie rock.

kris the $pirit.bio: Montréal rapper Kris the $pirit first built a following as half of The Posterz before launching a solo run rooted in the city's underground hip-hop scene and his own production-heavy, introspective style.

sic sense.bio: Scarborough hip-hop group Sic Sense formed in the mid-1990s around members Dub ILL, 6Pak and Boom, becoming part of Toronto's independent boom-bap scene through records including Positional Bypass and Onemantality.

korry deez.bio: Scarborough rapper Korry Deez is a Canadian hip-hop artist best known as a member of IRS and the Monolith collective, part of Toronto's influential late-1990s and early-2000s underground rap scene.

korey deez.bio: Scarborough rapper Korry Deez, whose name also appears in the library as Korey Deez, is a Canadian hip-hop artist best known as a member of IRS and the Monolith collective.

spesh k.bio: Halifax rapper Spesh K, born Kevin Kinch, is a longtime East Coast Canadian hip-hop artist whose independent catalogue, MuchMusic exposure and work with the group Fax 4 helped build his reputation in Nova Scotia's rap scene.

terell safadi.bio: Vancouver rapper Terell Safadi is a Canadian West Coast independent artist whose catalogue and touring career include collaborations with The Game, DJ Mustard, Tory Lanez and Pressa.

pony.bio: Toronto band PONY, led by singer-guitarist Sam Bielanski, makes fuzzy melodic power pop that draws on grunge, indie rock and hook-heavy guitar pop.
